g.text: Build, host or call an API: start with the API
move down the stack only when cost, control or data demand it
pretrain or heavily train a model
full control and a possible moat
model on your own infra or cloud
lower marginal cost at steady volume;
data stays in your VPC; no surprise
call a hosted model, directly or
via Azure, AWS or Google Cloud
no infra; prices tend to fall
prototype on an API, measure with evals, then route
narrow, high-volume tasks to a smaller or open model
